```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

# Reference base configuration
resources:
  - ../../base

# Production-specific patches applied only in this overlay
patches:
  # 1. Scale web application deployment to 4 replicas
  - patch: |
      apiVersion: apps/v1
      kind: Deployment
      metadata:
        name: web-app
      spec:
        replicas: 4
    target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: web-app

  # 2 & 3. Upgrade RDS instance class and enable multi-AZ
  # Assumes Crossplane PostgreSQL or similar CRD structure
  - patch: |
      spec:
        parameters:
          instanceClass: db.t3.medium
          multiAZ: true
    target:
      kind: PostgreSQL
      name: main-db

  # 4. Add S3 cross-region replication to us-west-2
  # Assumes Crossplane Bucket or similar CRD structure
  - patch: |
      spec:
        parameters:
          replicationConfiguration:
            replicationRules:
              - status: Enabled
                destination:
                  bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-us-west-2
                  storageClass: STANDARD
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: app-assets

# Ensure prod environment labels are applied for observability/governance
commonLabels:
  environment: prod
  managed-by: knr-ops
```
